summary: Iteration 206 backend testing — reversal line-status fix, repair-reversal-lines, bulk-reverse endpoints, HR timesheets CRUD, days_worked_override + use_timesheets in payslip generator, manual payslip regression, payroll expense auto-tag via store_settings.default_cash_account_id (with preserve-on-second-paid semantics), self-service /payslips/mine + /payslips/{id}/mine (cross-user isolation), plus P&L / Balance-Sheet / attendance-summary regression. 14/14 pytest cases pass.

critical.issue: The bulk_delete_entries function in /app/backend/routers/accounting.py (line 725) is MISSING its @router.post decorator. It's declared immediately after bulk_reverse_entries' return block with no blank line, so it never gets registered as a FastAPI route. Any bulk-delete request from the UI will 404 (or match a wrong route). Regression from this iteration's edits (bulk-reverse was added in this iteration).

action_items: Add back the missing `@router.post("/entries/bulk-delete")` decorator above the `bulk_delete_entries` function in /app/backend/routers/accounting.py (line 725). Insert a blank line between the previous function's closing `}` and the new decorator for readability.
critical_code_review_comments: accounting.py:725 — bulk_delete_entries is declared without @router.post decorator. This means the entries/bulk-delete UI action wired in AccountingPage will silently fail. High-severity regression introduced by this iteration.
hr.py:_aggregate_payroll_expense correctly preserves paid_from_account_id on aggregation (line 644 — `if paid_from and not existing.get('paid_from_account_id')`). Verified.

hr.py:_generate_payslips_for uses days_worked_override to prorate gross via `wd_after_unpaid` denominator — this differs from the review-request formula `(working_days-15)/working_days * base`; tests were written against the actual implementation (equivalent when unpaid_days=0). Consider clarifying spec vs. implementation if PTO/unpaid days should factor into the denominator differently.

reverse_entry (accounting.py:636) correctly forces reversal entry_lines status to 'posted' — this is the actual fix that resolves the reported 'income + net profit already reversed still shows in reports' bug.

rca of the issue: bulk_delete_entries missing decorator: while adding /entries/bulk-reverse in this iteration, the pre-existing bulk_delete_entries function's `@router.post` line was accidentally deleted (compare with iter202 tests which relied on it). Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BACKEND/api/accounting/entries/bulk-delete -H 'Auth ...' -d '{"ids":[]}'` should return 400 but currently returns 404. Fix: prepend `@router.post("/entries/bulk-delete")` on the line immediately before `async def bulk_delete_entries(...)` at accounting.py:725.
